title: Aptamers without SELEX: De novo design from protein structure in hours.
authors: Dolgusheva, Vladislava A; Leibin, Iosif V; Kudryashova, Natalia O; Mukanov, Artem R; Kuznetsov, Ivan I; Manasyan, Artem L; Pavlyuk, Gleb A; Mishkorez, Ivan V; Keremet, Anna M; Podlesnyi, Pavel R; Kalinkin, Alexey N; Avdeev, Kirill S; Kuznetsov, Maxim D; Parfenov, Nikita O; Gromov, Stanislav M; Ufaev, Dmitry; Nasaev, Shamsudin S
one_liner_zh: 该文提出Xelari模块化流程，从蛋白质结构出发从头设计DNA/RNA适配体，结合物理/结构参考的代理模型，虽对象为适配体而非蛋白质，但其基于结构的生成与评分方法可迁移至蛋白质结构相关计算，具有借鉴价值。
abstract: Systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (SELEX)-based aptamer discovery can be constrained by target availability, selection biases, and optimization requirements. We introduce Xelari, a modular pipeline for de novo DNA and RNA aptamer design from protein structures without target-specific SELEX data or retraining. Xelari combines algorithmic modules with surrogate models trained on physical or structural references. InNA reproduced nucleotide-amino-acid interaction energies with RMSE of 0.19 kcal/mol across 483,735 reference pairs. AliNA achieved a mean F1 of 0.757 on 339 PDB-derived RNA evaluation sequences. Edgar correlated with experimental folding energies but did not reproduce their absolute scale, supporting its use as a ranking heuristic. Under the reported calibration, ValentiNA showed MAE of 0.931 kcal/mol and Spearman rho of 0.795 across 32 retrospective records associated with 27 structural templates; this analysis does not establish family-independent validation. Prospectively, three DNA aptamers designed against Treponema pallidum protein structures showed cell-associated binding in a treponeme assay (apparent K(D), 0.91-2.57 muM). A fourth DNA aptamer served as a capture reagent in a serum-based hybrid aptamer-antibody assay for Tau441. These applications support feasibility without establishing intended-target engagement in the cellular assay or a general success rate, positioning structure-based design as a complement to experimental selection.
abstract_zh: 基于指数富集的配体系统进化（SELEX）的适配体发现可能受到靶标可用性、选择偏差和优化要求的限制。我们引入了Xelari，一种模块化流程，用于从蛋白质结构出发进行从头DNA和RNA适配体设计，无需靶标特异性SELEX数据或重新训练。Xelari将算法模块与基于物理或结构参考训练的替代模型相结合。InNA在483,735个参考对上重现了核苷酸-氨基酸相互作用能，均方根误差（RMSE）为0.19 kcal/mol。AliNA在339个PDB来源的RNA评估序列上实现了平均F1分数0.757。Edgar与实验折叠能相关，但未重现其绝对尺度，支持其作为排序启发式方法的使用。在报告的校准下，ValentiNA在27个结构模板相关的32个回顾性记录中显示出平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.931 kcal/mol，Spearman rho为0.795；该分析未建立家族无关的验证。在前瞻性应用中，针对梅毒螺旋体（Treponema pallidum）蛋白质结构设计的三个DNA适配体在螺旋体测定中显示出细胞相关结合（表观K(D)，0.91-2.57 μM）。第四个DNA适配体在基于血清的杂交适配体-抗体测定中作为捕获试剂用于Tau441。这些应用支持可行性，但未在细胞测定中建立预期靶标结合或一般成功率，将基于结构的设计定位为实验选择的补充方法。
